[[File:Joe Boulden InQuest 17 (1996).jpg|thumb|right|260px|Boulden at Decipher in 1996. Photo: InQuest.]]
'''Joe Boulden''' was a Decipher digital artist and the 3D project manager of the [[Jedi Knights Trading Card Game]] (2001), coordinating the Art Department's work on it. He found 3D modelers who had made ''Star Wars'' fan art, in eleven countries, and Decipher bought and enhanced their models.<ref name="jkrules">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt ''Jedi Knights'' Trading Card Game rulebook (credits)], Decipher (2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010820125115/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/rules/jediknightsrules.txt Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkpersonae">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Design Diary: Dramatis personae], decipher.com (2000–2001). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010224092942/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/personae.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="jkd102500">[http://www.decipher.com/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102500.html Design Diary, 25 October 2000], decipher.com. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001208001800/http://www.decipher.com:80/jediknights/designdiary/entries/102500.html Internet Archive]</ref> In 1996 ''[[InQuest]]'' described him retouching film frames for ''Star Wars'' CCG cards and pictured him with a set of press sheets.<ref name="iq17">Rick Swan, "Star Tours: How a ''Star Wars'' card is made", ''[[InQuest]]'' 17 (September 1996), pp. 54–60. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/inquest-issue-17-images_202008/page/n55/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref> In 2002 he explained in ''Star Trek Communicator'' how Decipher's art department turned film frames into ''[[Star Trek CCG]]'' card images.<ref name="stc138">[[Richard Handley|Rich Handley]], "Rec Deck: Creating the Star Trek CCG", ''Star Trek Communicator'' 138 (2002), Decipher, pp. 72–74. Scan: [https://archive.org/details/star-trek-communicator-issue-138/page/n75/mode/1up Internet Archive].</ref>

The credits page of the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] rules booklet (1995) thanks Joe Boulden "for hours of retouching, stroke by stroke".<ref name="2p-credits">[https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Introductory Two-Player Game Rules Booklet], Decipher / Parker Brothers (1995), credits page. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261015192404/https://www.hasbro.com/common/instruct/Star_Wars_Customizable_Card_Game.PDF Internet Archive]</ref>
